test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

He said, "Have you brought your original marksheets here with you?"

options.text: He asked me if I have taken my original marksheets here with me.
He asked me if I took my original marksheets there with me.
He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with me.
He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with me.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Have you brought" becomes "if I had taken"**
 
 
• Reporting verb "said" changes to "asked" to match the question format.
 
• Verb "have brought" is converted to "had taken" to reflect the past tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"your original marksheets here" becomes "my original marksheets there"**
 
 
• Pronoun "your" is changed to "my" to match the perspective of the speaker.
 
• Adverb "here" is changed to "there" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted to a statement without quotation marks.
 
• Question form is retained indirectly with "if".
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He asked me if I have taken my original marksheets here with me." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "have taken" should be changed to "had taken" in indirect speech.
 
• Incorrect adverb: "here" should be changed to "there."
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He asked me if I took my original marksheets there with me." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "took" does not correctly reflect the original question format.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with them." 
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: "them" does not match the original sentence context.
